name: Size / Sign Rank
details: The rank of a matrix is at most its number of rows.
proof: The incidence sign matrix of \(\mathcal H\) has \(|\mathcal H|\) rows. Any real matrix realizing its sign pattern has rank at most its number of rows, so minimizing this rank gives \(\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)\le |\mathcal H|\).
